footer.tagline: Live volleyball statistics. Log every action, follow the score in real time and improve match after match.

hero.subtitle: Log the match from your iPad while you coach — even with no connection —, share the score and stats live and break down every set when it's over. Say goodbye to paper scoresheets.

product.title: Take control of the whole match
product.text: Log every action with the quick grid — designed so one person can coach and record at the same time — or straight on the court map with Rally Map (available on the Normal plan), with attack and serve trajectories. You choose the detail: every touch or just the actions that end the rally. And you make your substitutions with data, not gut feeling.
product.point1: Score, rotation and server update on their own.
product.point2: Automatic detection of scoring and error runs.
product.point3: Breakdown per player and per court area.
product.point4: Filter the stats set by set.

how.title: From the court to the report in three steps
how.subtitle: No learning curve. Start logging in your very first match.
how.step1Text: Record every play from your iPad with the quick grid or on the court map, with substitutions, timeouts and graded reception. Works offline, in any gym.
how.step2Text: With the Pro plan or a match pass, share the match code and broadcast the score and stats live. Watching it from the web is always free for whoever gets the code.
how.step3Text: When it's over, you get the full match report: side-out and break, rotations, attack maps (if you captured with Rally Map) and much more. With the Normal plan, export it as a PDF to review with the team.

features.title: Everything your coaching staff needs
features.subtitle: Tools built for coaches, analysts and players.
features.f1Text: Follow the result set by set and how the match unfolds in real time from any device. Broadcasting the live feed is a Pro plan feature (or a match pass); watching it is always free.
features.f2Text: Evaluate individual performance in every area and find your roster's strengths.
features.f3Text: Side-out and break, attack by phase (K1/K2) and by pass quality, reception graded on 4 levels and setter-attacker connections.
features.f4Text: Visualize point and error runs to understand the key moments of every set.
features.f5Text: With the Normal plan, export match and season reports as PDFs to share with your coaching staff and players.
features.f6Text: Share a simple code and the whole team can check the stats online, no complicated sign-ups.
features.f7Text: Check the aggregated history against each opponent: their rotations, reception against your servers, their attack lanes and danger zones, with the key points always at hand.
features.f8Text: Compare two matches side by side: key metrics, side-out by rotation and who scored the points in each one.
features.f9Text: Automatic warnings during the match: opponent run, player on a streak, set point, stuck rotation or predictable attack, so you can react in time.
features.f10Text: A panel built for the 3-minute break: phases, rotations, opponent trends and the next set's key points in plain language.
features.f11Text: With the Normal plan, every player gets a full profile: skill radar, attack, serve-reception and physical evolution, inside the season dashboard.

download.title: Take your team to the next level
download.text: Download Voley Stats for iPad and log your next match for free. Go Normal whenever you want the season history, PDF reports and cloud backup, or Pro to share your matches live.

faq.title: Questions?
faq.subtitle: And if you can't find your answer, write to us at voleystats{'@'}gmail.com and we'll help.
faq.a1: It's the live web companion of Voley Stats, the iPad app for capturing and analyzing volleyball statistics. You record every action of the match from the app, and anyone can follow the score and stats live on this web, free and with no sign-up.
faq.q2: How do I check my team's stats online?
faq.a2: Go to the 'Watch live' section, enter your team code and access the live score and match stats, with a breakdown per set and per player.
faq.a3: Everything that happens on the court: every touch or just the rally-ending actions, attack and serve trajectories on the court map, reception graded on 4 levels, serve quality, K1/K2 phase tracking, substitutions and timeouts. The score, rotation and server update on their own.
faq.q4: Can I download a match report?
faq.a4: Yes. When the match ends the app builds a full report: side-out and break, where the points came from, rotations, attack by phase and by pass quality, setter-attacker connections, unforced errors and attack maps (if you captured that match with Rally Map). Exporting it as a PDF is available with the Normal plan or with a match pass for that match.
faq.q5: Do I need an internet connection?
faq.a5: Not for logging: the app works fully offline, so you can capture and check stats in any gym. You only need internet to share the live feed on this web, and for the OBS overlay or the public team page (both Pro plan features), or for cloud backup (Normal plan).
faq.a6: Downloading the app and logging your matches — full capture and stats for every match and set — is free. The Normal plan (€19.99/year or €3.99/month) adds Rally Map, the team history and season stats with filters, PDF reports, multi-device sync, cloud backup and team/tournament export. The Pro plan (€34.99/year or €6.99/month) adds sharing matches live, the OBS overlay, the public team page and sharing the team with other coaches. There's also a €2.99 match pass to unlock the live feed, Rally Map and the PDF report for a single match, no subscription needed. Watching the live feeds on the web is always free for whoever gets the code.

paragraphs: This policy explains what data the Voley Stats app for iPad and this website (voleystats.vercel.app) process, and how we protect it.

sections.heading: Data controller
paragraphs: Voley Stats is developed by Pau Hermosilla, an individual developer. For any privacy questions, write to voleystats{'@'}gmail.com.

sections.heading: The app works offline and without an account
paragraphs: Voley Stats works entirely offline and without creating an account. If you don't enable any of the features described below, no data leaves your device.

sections.heading: What data we process
paragraphs: Depending on how you use the app, we may process:
list: Account (optional): if you choose to create an account, your email and password are managed with Firebase Authentication (Google).

Content you create: teams, players (name, jersey number, position, birth date, physical measurements) and match statistics. This content is stored on your device and is only transmitted if you enable live sharing (Firebase Firestore), device sync, or cloud backup (Supabase).
Player photos: never leave your device; they are not uploaded to any server.

sections.heading: Statistics published live
paragraphs: When you enable live sharing from the app, the scoreboard and match statistics are published in real time on this website and are visible to anyone who has the match code. Players' birth dates are never included in statistics published live. The coach decides what to share for each match and can turn off live sharing at any time from the app.

sections.heading: Advertising, analytics and third parties
paragraphs: Voley Stats shows no ads, uses no third-party analytics, and we never sell or share your data. We use Firebase (Google) and Supabase solely as data processors to provide the live sharing, sync and backup features you enable; your data travels encrypted (HTTPS). Payments for subscriptions and in-app purchases are processed by Apple through the App Store: we never see or store your card details. Your subscription status is verified on our server (Supabase), tied to your account, to enable the corresponding features.

sections.heading: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: We keep your account data for as long as the account exists. You can delete it, along with your backups and synced data, at any time — see how in Delete account (voleystats.vercel.app/delete-account).

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification and erasure over your personal data by writing to voleystats{'@'}gmail.com.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time; the last-updated date appears at the top of this page.

sections.heading: Option 1: from the app
paragraphs: Open Voley Stats, go to your Profile, and open the settings tab. Tap "Delete account". This permanently deletes your account, your cloud backups, and your synced data.

sections.heading: Option 2: without access to the app
paragraphs: Send an email to voleystats{'@'}gmail.com from the address you registered with, with the subject "Delete account". We'll process the request within 30 days and confirm by email once it's done.

sections.heading: What gets deleted
paragraphs: Deleting your account removes:
list: Live-shared matches associated with your account.

sections.heading: What doesn't get deleted
paragraphs: Data stored locally on your device is not deleted when you delete your account; to remove it, uninstall the app. Exported or sent PDF reports are also not deleted, since they are not part of our systems.

sections.heading: Note
paragraphs: Removing the app from your device does not delete your account: follow the process above to delete it completely.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.note: This document is an informative template and does not constitute legal advice.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are and scope
paragraphs: Voley Stats is an iPad app, available on the App Store, for capturing and analyzing volleyball statistics. This website (voleystats.vercel.app) lets you follow matches live and view reports and statistics shared from the app. These terms govern the use of both.

sections.heading: 2. Acceptance
paragraphs: By using the app or the website you accept these terms of use and our privacy policy. If you do not agree with them, do not use the service.

sections.heading: 3. The app
paragraphs: We grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the app. The app offers subscriptions (the Normal and Pro plans) and a one-time match pass purchase, handled through Apple's App Store and governed by its terms. Apple's standard EULA applies to the app.

sections.heading: 4. The website
paragraphs: Access to the website is free and requires no registration. Match and team links are public: anyone with the link can view their content.

sections.heading: 5. Content and coach responsibility
paragraphs: Captured statistics belong to whoever captures them. By enabling live sharing or sharing a link, the user authorizes their publication on the website and declares having the necessary consents from the people whose data appears (players' names and jersey numbers, including minors, under the responsibility of the club or coach). You can disable live sharing from the app at any time.

sections.heading: 6. Acceptable use
paragraphs: It is forbidden to use the service for unlawful purposes, to perform massive automated access (scraping), to interfere with the operation of the service or to attempt to access other teams' data without having their link.

sections.heading: 7. Intellectual property
paragraphs: The software, brand, design and generated reports belong to Voley Stats or its licensors. The statistics belong to the user who captures them.

sections.heading: 8. Availability and warranties
paragraphs: The service is provided "as is". Statistics are for informational and sporting purposes: we do not guarantee their accuracy or the continuous availability of the service, and we are not responsible for decisions made based on them.

sections.heading: 9. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, we shall not be liable for indirect damages arising from the use of the service. Nothing in these terms limits the rights granted to you by consumer law.

sections.heading: 10. Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms by publishing the new version on this page with its update date.

sections.heading: 11. Governing law and jurisdiction
paragraphs: These terms are governed by Spanish law. When you act as a consumer, the courts of your place of residence shall have jurisdiction.

sections.heading: 12. Contact
paragraphs: For any questions about these terms you can write to us at voleystats{'@'}gmail.com.
